summary_1line: After Bhishma’s fall, Dhritarashtra mourns and asks Sanjaya what the Kauravas did as the armies, shaken yet bound by duty, prepare to fight again.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies on a bed of arrows with a pillow of shafts while warriors from both armies stand around him in solemn respect.
The Kaurava army, shaken after Bhishma’s fall, stands scattered and fearful like a herd without a herdsman on a battlefield at dusk.
Dhritarashtra sits in the palace with tear-filled eyes while Sanjaya returns from the battlefield to report the events of Bhishma’s fall.
